name: Industrial Discipline
history: Industrial Discipline fue un grupo activo entre 2011 y 2012, de estilo industrial metal con influencias de Fear Factory, Divine Heresy, Threat Signal, Sybreed, Mnemic, Ktulu y Diesel Machine.
historyEn: Industrial Discipline was a band active between 2011 and 2012, of industrial metal style with influences of Fear Factory, Divine Heresy, Threat Signal, Sybreed, Mnemic, Ktulu and Diesel Machine.
